pin_regs.reason: Source-registered, unchanged per-bit edges (release freeze): every input lands in a flop (td -> txd_p, tvk/crk -> slice tv_q/cr_q, li_d -> rd_q, tx_v/lo_r -> kept kf copies, li_v -> rv_q/cr_q/credit check, lf/ovf_t -> flt_q) and every output leaves a flop (lod = slice ld, lv/ovf, rx_d, rx_v, li_r, flt, tvk/crk, reset leaves). A recipe pin stage would add an edge to the frozen latency contract.

reset_landing.reason: rst_n lands in 2 ck flops, then the child's own ot_rst_relay_tree3 (<= 12 slice leaves or {lane, rx, misc}); every sibling child lands rst_n identically, so all reset leaves release on the same edge as before (uniform +2 vs the flat lane; the parent p9 disables its own landing).

fill_reason.pin_bound: pin-bound: 288 li_d + 288 rx_d pins + control, ~0.31k sinks on a 86.4 x 108.0 um stacked sub-child of the 583-um lane strip (faces <= 3.1 pins/um); outline set by the lane child's facing pins, never shrink.
